summary: Threads keep an unconfirmed rename or lifecycle change visible without offering to resend an action whose outcome is unknown.

replay.detail: No history replay or rebuild changes.

schema.detail: No storage or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: Delivery certainty and grants are unchanged; unknown actions remain non-replayable.

compatibility.detail: The web notice no longer depends on a retry callback. Existing pending changes remain visible and keep conflicting changes disabled.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes to recover.
